## Parallels RAS — Infrastructure Overview

_Designed and developed by **Silvio Di Benedetto**, CEO at Inside Technologies, Microsoft MVP and Parallels VIPP._

---

This workbook provides full-stack monitoring of a **Parallels RAS 20.x / 21.x** farm connected to Azure Monitor via two independent pipelines:

- **Pipeline A — Windows telemetry (Azure Monitor Agent):** performance counters (CPU, RAM, disk, network, Terminal Services sessions) and Windows Event Log entries are collected by AMA on all farm servers (Azure Arc-enabled) and streamed into the native `Perf` and `Event` tables.
- **Pipeline B — RAS-specific data (PowerShell + Logs Ingestion API):** a scheduled PowerShell script running on the Connection Broker queries the Parallels RAS API every 5 minutes and publishes structured JSON payloads to four custom tables: `RASServer_CL` (server inventory and roles), `RASAgent_CL` (agent versions per server), `RASSession_CL` (active RDP sessions), `RASAudit_CL` (administrator sessions and audit events).

Credentials are stored in **Azure Key Vault**; the collector authenticates to Azure using the server's **Managed Identity** — no secrets are stored in scripts or Task Scheduler.

**Tabs:**
- **Overview** — KPI tiles (monitored servers, active sessions, error events, distinct agent versions) and a per-server summary with CPU, RAM and recent error count.
- **Events** — Parallels RAS application events only (all providers), filtered from the Windows Event Log by source name.
- **Services & Versions** — server coverage by role, agent version distribution (donut) and full agent inventory grid.
- **Performance** — CPU and RAM time-series charts, split by role: Session Host (RDSH) vs other roles (Broker, Gateway, Provider). Session counter chart for RDSH servers.
- **Sessions** — real-time snapshot of active RDP sessions (last 10 minutes): by state, by host and full session detail table.
- **Audit** — administrator activity: actions by admin user, events by source, and full audit log grid.

Data sources: `Perf` · `Event` (Azure Monitor Agent) + `RASServer_CL` · `RASAgent_CL` · `RASSession_CL` · `RASAudit_CL` (Logs Ingestion API).

parameters.name: Farm
parameters.label: Farm
parameters.query: RASServer_CL | where isnotempty(FarmName) | distinct FarmName | order by FarmName asc

content.query:
union
(RASServer_CL | where Role !in ('RDSGroup','VDITemplate','VDIPool') | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer | summarize v = dcount(Computer) | extend Metric = 'Monitored servers', o = 1),
(RASSession_CL | where TimeGenerated > ago(10m) | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SessionId | summarize v = count() | extend Metric = 'Active sessions', o = 2),
(Event | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where (Source startswith 'Parallels' or Source == '2X Remote Application Server') or (Source == 'Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager' and EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40)) | where EventLevelName in ('Error','Critical') | summarize v = count() | extend Metric = 'Error/Critical events', o = 3),
(RASAgent_CL | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer | summarize v = dcount(AgentVersion) | extend Metric = 'Distinct agent versions', o = 4)
| order by o asc
| project Metric, v
content.title: Key indicators
Server details

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where (Source startswith "Parallels" or Source == "2X Remote Application Server") or (Source == "Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager" and EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40))
| summarize Count = count() by EventLevelName
| order by Count desc
content.title: Events by severity

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where (Source startswith "Parallels" or Source == "2X Remote Application Server") or (Source == "Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager" and EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40))
| summarize Count = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), EventLevelName
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Event trend over time

content.query:
Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where (Source startswith "Parallels" or Source == "2X Remote Application Server") or (Source == "Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager" and EventID in (21, 23, 24, 25, 40))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventLevelName, EventID, Source, Message = substring(RenderedDescription, 0, 200)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 300
content.title: Recent events

content.query:
RASServer_CL
| where Role !in ('RDSGroup','VDITemplate','VDIPool')
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, Role
| summarize Servers = dcount(Computer) by Role
| order by Servers desc
content.title: Server coverage by role

content.query:
RASAgent_CL
| where isnotempty(AgentVersion)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| summarize Servers = count() by AgentVersion
| order by Servers desc
content.title: Agent version distribution

content.query:
RASAgent_CL
| where isnotempty(AgentVersion)
| extend NK = tolower(tostring(split(Computer, '.')[0]))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by NK, AgentType
| project Computer, SiteName, AgentType, AgentState, AgentVersion, OSVersion
| order by Computer asc
content.title: Installed agents

content.query:
RASSession_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SessionId
| summarize Sessions = count() by SessionState
| order by Sessions desc
content.title: Sessions by state

content.query:
RASSession_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SessionId
| summarize Sessions = count() by Computer
| order by Sessions desc
content.title: Sessions by host

content.query:
RASSession_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer, SessionId
| project LogonTime, UserName, Computer, SiteName, ClientName, ClientIP, SessionState, SessionType, PublishedResource, IdleTimeSec
| order by LogonTime desc
content.title: Active sessions

content.query:
RASAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Actions = count() by AdminUser
| order by Actions desc
| take 15
content.title: Activity by administrator

content.query:
RASAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by Source
| order by Count desc
content.title: Audit events by source

content.query:
RASAudit_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| project TimeGenerated, AdminUser, Action, ObjectType, ObjectName, Result, ClientIP, Source
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 300
content.title: Administrator / operator audit log

content.json: > **Note:** Detailed configuration change audit resides in the **RAS Reporting DB**. This view shows admin sessions collected via PowerShell + Connection Broker events from the Windows channel.
